steps.note: Open the single-stage creation screen requested by the scenario.
Enable eRFX functionality required by the requested event flow.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required by the case.
Configure the closest supported auction type; sealed bid is not available in the catalog.
Select the closest reverse buy-auction template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the requested product and quantity.
Populate the remaining required pricing-sheet fields.
Set the requested delivery location on the first line item.
Invite three QA vendors without inventing vendor names.
Publish the auction so vendors can bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Submit the first vendor bid at 100.
Confirm the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit the second vendor bid at 95.
Confirm the second vendor bid was accepted.
Verify the buyer's auction Responses view shows both vendor bids.
